dataList.content:
You should have stabbed me! That harpoon should have pierced my heart! How! Why were you the one to—!
你应该刺向我的！那支鱼叉应该刺向我的！为什么！是由你！为什么是由你！
dataList.place:
The Pallid Whale's Heart
白鲸的心脏

dataList.content:
We must find the Pallid Whale! Look alive, men! Spring! Roar!
我们必须找到白鲸！所有人睁大眼睛！喊啊！

Harpooneers, tighten the ropes around your harpoons! Helmsman, set course to the Whale!
鱼叉手！系紧捕鲸枪！舵手让船转向！

Full sail! Full sail, my first mate! Row! To the Pallid Whale from which the all evils of the world spout, we sail!
大副扬帆！划桨！向着喷涌出这世间万恶的那白鲸的位置……

Navigators, chart course…! We set sail! We set… sail…
我的船副们啊！启航……！启航……

Ahab roars. She cries out to her crew, but they will never return.
亚哈向着永远回不来的船员们，大叫呼喊着。

Her voice scatters to nothingness.
随后，那些叫喊消散得无影无踪。

I will watch you live. Because you are the proof of my wandering years.
我会一直注视着活着的你。因为你是我彷徨过的证据。

So that I may endlessly struggle against the devouring seas. The testament to my sins. My Whale.
你是为了能让我无休止地抵抗而不被吞噬的，我罪过的证人。我的鲸。

No, you will not look down at me…!
不可以，不准那样轻视我！

I am Captain Ahab. I, I…!
我是亚哈。我是……！

Pale blood explodes from the gaping rupture in the Whale’s heart.
从心脏的裂隙间，白色的血液开始喷涌而出。

As though the Pequod’s crew were raising a toast to victory.
仿佛裴廓德号的全体船员正在举杯庆祝胜利一般。

Drink to the Pallid Whale's death.
庆祝那白鲸的最终之死。

Drink to the downfall of Captain Ahab.
庆祝那亚哈的最终倒台。

Thus the voyage came to an end.
航海结束了。

Oi... The Whale's not letting us out, it's caving in on itself...!
喂……哪里能到外面去啊，这鲸在塌陷啊……！

So what she said about destroying the heart and escaping...
所以她说破坏心脏就能出去的话也是……

Of course... Full of lies to the end.
果然……到最后都净是谎言啊。

Well, it technically wasn't a lie. We will eventually end up outside the Whale.
不，那不是谎言。出去是可能的。

She didn't say anything about being outside the Whale in one piece, I guess. Ugh, I shoulda seen this coming~
但没说过我们能活着出去。这种事情很常见呢~

THUMP!
嗵！

Someone, something dropped a large, sturdy rope from above us.
从上面垂下了巨大的绳子。

<Who dropped that rope...?>
<谁扔下来的绳子？>

Doesn't matter, let's take it!
那种事情无所谓啦，快点爬上去吧！

Ishmael stared at that rope for a moment.
以实玛利盯着那根绳子看了一会儿。

What are you standing around there for? Let's go.
怎么了？快点爬上去吧。

This rope...
这根绳子……

I have a feeling that this rope won't snap.
不知为何，我有种它不会断的感觉。

You... You should have killed me...
你……你应该杀掉我的……

I should have been the one to kill the Whale...!
而杀死这头鲸的本该是我……！

What... about her?
那家伙……怎么办？

... We'll let her watch as this place crumbles around her.
……让她尽情欣赏这个正在崩坏的地方吧。

The Captain must go down with the ship, after all.
毕竟作为船长，直到船沉没为止都要与船同在。

We all grabbed onto the rope and climbed.
大家抓着绳子爬了上去。

Like Ishmael said, this rope did not snap. We felt the cool breeze blowing in from the outside.
正如以实玛利所说，绳子没有断。清风从外界吹来。

We never once looked back at the abyss that was the Whale.
我们再也没有回头去看鲸喉咙下的深渊。

Never.
再也没有。

After some time...
过了一段时间……

Apparently the Whale's hide's too thick and tough for most things to puncture...
话说回来……好像说过那头鲸的表皮过于坚硬，用普通的方法是绝对无法刺穿的吧。

dataList.content:
That butterfly looks similar to the one we saw in the Lobotomy Corp. Branch.
和那个时候在脑叶公司支部船上遇到的，那只蝴蝶很像呢。

It appears to be the exact same Butterfly.
准确来说看上去像是同一只蝴蝶。

I'm envious. To be able to cross the Lakes so unbound, so freely like that.
能像那样自由地飞过湖面，好羡慕啊。

<What do you think his deal was? Rim...>
<那个叫林的人，他的真面目到底是什么？>

<He did help us at the end of the day, but...>
<虽然最终还是得到了他的帮助……>

He has certain expectations of us. I expect that he will return.
他看上去对我们有所期待。可以推测他还会回来。

I don't like being a pawn in some dodgy bloke's games.
总感觉……变成了他的棋子一样，让人不爽。

I think... he was watching us from a short distance away. Maybe a step away.
我觉得……他好像在离我们不远的地方注视着我们。

Ishmael was gazing beyond the Lake's horizons.
以实玛利从刚才开始就眺望着湖面上的地平线。

She no longer casts her gaze into its waters.
已经，不再凝视着湖水之中了。

<Ishmael.>
<以实玛利。>

Oh, I was reading the winds.
啊，我在确认风向。

We're cutting it close. I expect to see the Waves rushing in our direction at any minute.
差不多是时间了。浪潮肯定就要接近了。

Ishmael chuckled lightly.
以实玛利轻轻地笑了。

Then let's face it head-on this time. Ready, Dante?
这次来一起面对吧。准备好了吗，但丁？

<I... don't know how to sail.>
<我……不是很懂航海的方法。>

Haah... Don't you understand? After all that? It doesn't matter how good of a sailor you are.
哈啊，还不明白吗？无论掌握了何等高超的驾船技术……

What's important... is that someone is there to help steer you right.
最为重要的……是有谁将你引导至正确的方向。

And as the first mate of this ship, I'll trust and follow your directions.
并且我作为这艘船的大副，会相信着你指引的方向前行。

So... you're my Captain. For now.
所以……你现在是我的船长了。

My skiff will go on an adventure of its own one day. But for now, I've tied that skiff to a bigger ship called Limbus Company and you.
我会将自己那总有一天会踏上冒险的小船，与你和边狱公司这艘大船绑在一起，一同前行。

Because I really want to find out what's waiting for me at the end of this voyage.
这场航行的终点存在着什么，十分令人在意吧。

... Besides, you guys are the only friends I have left.
……况且，我也没有你们之外的朋友了。

<Ishmael...>
<以实玛利……>

I'll trust your decisions and your orders, Captain. But I'm not going to just accept them at a face value. I'll constantly question and try to understand them.
但是在相信船长的判断与命令的同时，我也会不断地去怀疑、质问、审视这些命令。

So that when I see that my compass no longer aligns with yours, I can take my skiff and sail away.
这样就算我的罗盘最终与你的不再相合，无论何时我都能乘着自己的船离开。

So that I won't let anything consume me again. So that I won't lose myself again.
为了不再被吞噬，不再失去自我。

I can see the Waves rushing toward us from a distance.
我望见了从远处逼近的浪潮。

The Waves are as colossal as always. There is a little fear in my heart.
是一如既往的巨大浪潮。感觉稍微有些可怕。

Yet...
但是……

<Well, I think we can manage that.>
<不过，并未到我们无法处理的程度。>

Heh.
呵。

Waves incoming in 15 seconds. Get to the helm, Swab— No.
浪潮来临还有15秒。掌舵，海猴……不。
